flows.title: Download a call's recording
steps: Select Analytics in the navigation bar on the left.
Open the call log by selecting Activity at the top of the page.
Find the call whose recording you want and use the arrow key to open that caller's timeline.
Select Download MP3 beneath the recording. The browser downloads it as an MP3 file to save wherever you like on your device. Repeat for each recording you want.

flows.title: Rename a tracking number
steps: Select the Settings icon on the left navigation bar.
Choose the company whose tracking number you want to rename.
Select Edit, the pencil icon, for that number.
In the Number Options section at the top of the page, select Edit (the pencil icon).
In Number Name, the first option, enter the new name. Pick something brief and memorable: the new name also shows on every earlier call to that number.
Select Save at the bottom of the section.
